units.source_text: 我看见了那张洁白的浮雕般的侧脸和那无与伦比的莹白的胸脯。

en.t: I saw that pure white profile, like a relief carving, and that incomparably luminous white breast.

units.source_text: 即使女子离去以后，那天剩下的时间，或第二天、第三天，我还执拗地寻思着。

en.t: Even after the woman had gone, through the rest of that day, and on the second and third days as well, I kept brooding over it stubbornly.

units.source_text: 的确，那女子就是复活了的有为子啊！

en.t: Surely, that woman was Uiko come back to life!
